arxiv-2110-12596.title: GeoSneakPique: Visual Autocompletion for Geospatial Queries
arxiv-2110-12596.creator: Vidya Setlur, Sarah Battersby, Tracy Wong
arxiv-2110-12596.description: Abstract How many crimes occurred in the city center? And exactly which part of town is the ‘city center’? While location is at the heart of many data questions, geographic location can be difficult to specify in natural language (NL) queries.

arxiv-2111-04635.title: CORE: a Complex Event Recognition Engine
arxiv-2111-04635.creator: Marco Bucchi, Alejandro Grez, Andrés Quintana, Cristian Riveros, Stijn Vansummeren
arxiv-2111-04635.description: Abstract . Complex Event Recognition (CER) systems are a prominent technology for finding user-defined query patterns over large data streams in real time. CER query evaluation is known to be computationally challenging, since it requires maintaining a set of partial matches, and this set quickly grows super-linearly in the number of processed events.

arxiv-2207-06600.title: Testing the scalar sector of the Standard-Model Extension with neutron gravity experiments
arxiv-2207-06600.creator: C. A. Escobar, A. Martín-Ruiz, A. M. Escobar-Ruiz, Román Linares
arxiv-2207-06600.description: Abstract In the present study we analyse, within the scalar sector of the Standard-Model Extension (SME) framework, the influence of a spontaneous Lorentz symmetry breaking on gravitational quantum states of ultracold neutrons. The model is framed according to the laboratory conditions of the recent high-sensitivity GRANIT and q q Bounce experiments.

arxiv-2209-05997.title: Origin of Enhanced Zone Lines in Field Desorption Maps
arxiv-2209-05997.creator: Jiayuwen Qi, Christian Oberdorfer, Emmanuelle A. Marquis, Wolfgang Windl
arxiv-2209-05997.description: Abstract Artifacts in the collective desorption map of the detector hits impede a truthful reconstruction, including enhanced “zone lines”with high atomic impact intensity. Since APT is destructive, simulation is the only approach to explain the origin of these zone lines, but previous work couldn’t reproduce them.

arxiv-2304-06057.title: Maximal fairness CCS: Computing methodologies Artificial intelligence
arxiv-2304-06057.creator: MaryBeth Defrance, Tijl De Bie
arxiv-2304-06057.description: Abstract . Fairness in AI has garnered quite some attention in research, and increasingly also in society. The so-called "Impossibility Theorem" has been one of the more striking research results with both theoretical and practical consequences, as it states that satisfying a certain combination of fairness measures is impossible.

arxiv-2312-13230.description: Abstract The MeerKAT International GigaHertz Tiered Extragalactic Exploration (MIGHTEE) is one of the MeerKAT large survey projects, designed to pathfind SKA key science. MIGHTEE is undertaking deep radio imaging of four well observed fields (COSMOS, XMM-LSS, ELAIS S1 and CDFS) totaling 20 square degrees to μ \mu Jy sensitivities.

arxiv-2401-08538.title: A Hidden Convexity of Nonlinear Elasticity
arxiv-2401-08538.creator: Siddharth Singh Janusz Ginster Amit Acharya
arxiv-2401-08538.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Siddharth Singh Janusz Ginster Amit Acharya. A technique for developing convex dual variational principles for the governing PDE of nonlinear elastostatics and elastodynamics is presented. This allows the definition of notions of a variational dual solution and a dual solution corresponding to the PDEs of nonlinear elasticity, even when the latter arise as formal Euler-Lagrange equations corresponding to non-quasiconvex elastic energy functionals whose energy minimizers do not exist.

arxiv-2601-18115.title: Robust Learning of a Group DRO Neuron
arxiv-2601-18115.creator: Guyang Cao, Shuyao Li, Sushrut Karmalkar, Jelena Diakonikolas
arxiv-2601-18115.description: Abstract We study the problem of learning a single neuron under standard squared loss in the presence of arbitrary label noise and group-level distributional shifts, for a broad family of covariate distributions. Our goal is to identify a “best-fit” neuron parameterized by 𝐰 ∗ \mathbf{w}_{*} that performs well under the most challenging reweighting of the groups.

pmc-10611777.title: Principal component analysis on twenty years (2000–2020) of geochemical and geophysical observations at Campi Flegrei active caldera

pmc-10611777.description: Campi Flegrei (CF) is an active and densely populated caldera in Southern Italy, which has manifested signs of significant unrest in the last 50 years. Due to the high volcanic risk, monitoring networks of the most sensitive unrest indicators have been implemented and improved over time.

pmc-10708866.title: An E2E Network Slicing Framework for Slice Creation and Deployment Using Machine Learning
pmc-10708866.creator: Sujitha Venkatapathy, Thiruvenkadam Srinivasan, Han-Gue Jo, In-Ho Ra
pmc-10708866.description: Network slicing shows promise as a means to endow 5G networks with flexible and dynamic features. Network function virtualization (NFV) and software-defined networking (SDN) are the key methods for deploying network slicing, which will enable end-to-end (E2E) isolation services permitting each slice to be customized depending on service requirements.

pmc-11532121.title: Investigating the impact of mental rehearsal on prefrontal and motor cortical haemodynamic responses in surgeons using optical neuroimaging
pmc-11532121.creator: Hemel N. Modi, Maia Osborne-Grinter, Ronak Patel, Ara Darzi, Daniel R. Leff, Harsimrat Singh
pmc-11532121.description: IntroductionInadequate exposure to real-life operating can impede timely acquisition of technical competence among surgical residents, and is a major challenge faced in the current training climate. Mental rehearsal (MR)—the cognitive rehearsal of a motor task without overt physical movement—has been shown to accelerate surgical skills learning. However, the neuroplastic effect of MR of a complex bimanual surgical task is unknown.

pmc-11592664.title: Pseudo-Quantum Electrodynamics: 30 Years of Reduced QED
pmc-11592664.creator: Eduardo C Marino, Leandro O Nascimento, Van Sérgio Alves, Danilo T Alves, Viktor Dodonov
pmc-11592664.description: Charged quasiparticles, which are constrained to move on a plane, interact by means of electromagnetic (EM) fields which are not subject to this constraint, living, thus, in three-dimensional space. We have, consequently, a hybrid situation where the particles of a given system and the EM fields (through which they interact) live in different dimensions.

pmc-12434196.title: The fibularis tertius muscle revisited: comparative anatomy, developmental classification, and evolutionary-clinical implications
pmc-12434196.creator: Łukasz Olewnik, Ingrid C. Landfald, Daria Domosławka, George Triantafyllou, Georgi P. Georgiev, Maria Piagkou
pmc-12434196.description: The fibularis tertius muscle (FTM) has long been regarded as an accessory or vestigial structure with inconsistent presence in the human population. However, recent anatomical, developmental, and biomechanical evidence suggests that FT is a functional and evolutionarily novel muscle with distinct clinical implications. This review synthesizes current knowledge on FT morphology, embryological development, phylogenetic context, imaging challenges, and surgical relevance.

pmc-13030290.title: Genome-Wide Identification of Candidate Loci Associated with the Regulation of the Protein, Oil, and Carbohydrate Content in Soybean

pmc-13030290.description: Soybean (Glycine max (L.) Merr.) is a globally important legume valued for the high protein, oil, and carbohydrate content of its seeds. However, it is difficult to simultaneously optimize the content of these three macronutrients due to their negatively correlated metabolic pathways and complex quantitative inheritance patterns.
